title: NASA Chased the Moon's Shadow at 50,000 Feet
description:
NASA chased the Moon's shadow at 50,000 feet during the August 12, 2026 total solar eclipse. Clouds covered Iceland, so a NASA WB-57 jet flew above them, racing the eclipse to film the Sun's corona. Here is how the flight worked, and what its cameras saw.

In this episode:
0:00 Clouds over Iceland on eclipse day
0:20 The mystery of the corona
0:34 A research jet from Houston
0:48 Racing the shadow
1:00 Why fly at 50,000 feet
1:14 Takeoff from Keflavik
1:25 Inside totality
1:48 Balloons below
1:59 What the team got
